id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

modelId.description: The id of the ml model that produced this feature importance value for {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}.

importanceValue.description:
The feature importance value for {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}.

This value represents the value the tag contributes to the subsytem, based on the trained ML model.

title:
The `GlobalFeatureImportanceHistory` entity represents historical records of feature importance values
for {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation} entities, generated by machine learning models.

This entity is useful for monitoring and analyzing the evolution of feature importance over time
in the context of reliability and asset-sensor relationships.
It extends {@link TimedValueHistory} to provide time-based tracking of feature importance data.
name: GlobalFeatureImportanceHistory
